أتهادر (form VI)
# أَتَهَادَرُ (ʔatahādaru) /ʔa.ta.haː.da.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَهَادَرَ (tahādara)
# أَتَهَادَرَ (ʔatahādara) /ʔa.ta.haː.da.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَهَادَرَ (tahādara)
# أَتَهَادَرْ (ʔatahādar) /ʔa.ta.haː.dar/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَهَادَرَ (tahādara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
